title: anvil.config.json - per-project settings for Anvil
description: Lives at the root of the repo under test. Every project-specific detail is here; the engine is generic. A missing optional section turns its checks into a clear 'skip'. Templates: {origin} {role} {page} {lane} {tester} {pr} {root} (repo root, or the temporary compare worktree for re-runs on main) {build} (<data_dir>/pr-<n>/build) {qa} (<data_dir>/pr-<n>) {filter} {flag} {tmp} (OS temp folder) {env:NAME} {env:NAME|default}. In list commands, items that become empty (like an unused {filter}) are dropped; a string command runs through the shell.

name.description: Product name shown in Anvil and in messages, e.g. "Acme Notes".

data_dir.description: Per-PR data folder, relative to the repo root (git-ignore it): <data_dir>/pr-<n>/.

focus_doc.description: Repo path of a Markdown file with module focus notes; the skill reads it when writing manual checks.

repo.description: owner/name. Default: parsed from `git remote get-url origin`. Without it, CI (A4), the PR list and posting are skipped.

testing_label.description: Label of PRs waiting for a tester ("start anvil" lists open PRs assigned to you with it).

app.description: The app under test, running locally.

origin_env.description: Environment variable that may override origin.

start_command.description: How to start the app (shown to testers, used by the skill). May mention {build}.

start_env.description: Environment variables the skill sets when it starts the app (templates allowed, e.g. {build}).

health_path.description: Path that answers < 500 when the app is up.

page_path.description: Path of a page; must contain {page}. Plan pages are the {page} part.

page_pattern.description: Regex every plan page must match (default: any safe relative path).

page_example.description: Example page shown in hints, e.g. member/notes.html.

api_base.description: Path prefix of API routes; plan access/flag paths are relative to it.

api_match.description: Substring that marks a request as an API call (failed-call detection and the session log).

api_context_path.description: Same-origin page opened before an API GET is sent (default: health_path).

login_path.description: Dev sign-in path that sets a session for a role; must contain {role}, may contain {page} for a redirect, e.g. /dev/login/{role}?next={page}. Without a page, the query parameter holding {page} is dropped. Without login_path every role browses signed out.

reset_path.description: Path that resets the test data (GET). Without it the Reset button is hidden.

sample_names.description: Regex of leftover placeholder names; a page showing one gets a warning.

list.description: Roles a tester can sign in as. "anon" (signed out) is always available.

default.description: Role for a page whose folder maps to no role (default: the first role).

folder_map.description: First folder of a page -> role, for pages listed without roles. A folder named like a role maps to it automatically.

build.description: Check A5. Absent: A5 is skipped.

command.description: Builds into {build} (never into a tracked folder).

detail_replace.description: Regex replace applied to the last output line before it is shown.

manifest.description: File in the build output listing the pages (JSON). With it, a plan page missing from the build fails.

manifest_key.description: Key in the manifest that holds the page map (keys = pages). Default: the whole file.

app_dir_env.description: Environment variable that points the app at a build folder; when set, its manifest is used instead of {build}.

app_dir.description: Repo path of the app's default build folder (manifest fallback).

tests.description: Checks A1 (suite), A2 (re-run failed files), A3 (failed files on the compare ref). Absent: A1 is skipped.

command.description: Runs the suite. {root} is the folder it runs in (repo root, or the compare worktree).

filter_args.description: Extra arguments to run only one file/filter, e.g. ["{filter}"]. Needed for A2/A3 and --test-filter.

summary_regex.description: Multi-line regex for the summary line with named groups total, failed, and optional secs and files. Absent: pass/fail by exit code only (no A2/A3).

file_section_end_regex.description: Regex that starts the next file's section in the output (to find a failed file's test names).

fail_name_regex.description: Multi-line regex whose group 1 is a failed test's name inside a file's section.

ok_line_regex.description: Regex of an output line that reports one passed test (for the live '<n> tests so far' count).

fail_line_regex.description: Regex of an output line that reports one failed test (live count).

log_line_regex.description: Only output lines matching it are streamed to the live log (default: every line).

files_dir.description: Repo path of the test files; a failed file missing on the compare ref is 'new in this PR'.

compare_ref.description: Local ref used for A3 (no fetch is done).

flags.description: Checks F-<id>: switch a feature flag off and on with a CLI and watch the API follow. Absent: F checks are skipped.

command.description: Base command of the flag tool.

list_args.description: Arguments that print the flags that are on (to restore them afterwards).

list_regex.description: Multi-line regex; group 1 = space-separated flags that are on. Without it the previous state is not restored.

none_text.description: Group-1 text that means no flag is on.

requires.description: Repo path that must exist, else the F checks are skipped.

missing_detail.description: Skip detail shown when 'requires' is missing.

flag_pattern.description: Regex every plan flag name must match.

review.description: How the report is posted and read.

lanes.description: Review lanes; one PR comment per lane in the plan.

ui_lane.description: Lane that gets phone/laptop (layout, accessibility) issues.

default_lane.description: Lane that gets every other auto-check issue.

pass_command.description: First line of a passing comment.

fix_command.description: Start of the first line of a fix request.

process_doc.description: Repo path of the team's testing process (for the skill).

owner.description: GitHub login of the final reviewer when the plan has none.

chat_name.description: Where testers paste the short note, e.g. Slack or Discord.

signature.description: Last line of every comment and the chat note; must contain {tester}.

recheck_command.description: Shown in the fix brief so the developer can re-run the failed checks.
